title: 介绍我的专业
subtitle: A little about me
goal: 读懂一段介绍，再用自己的信息说三句话。

paragraphs.text: My name is Lin, and I am a computer science student. I chose this subject because I enjoy solving problems. At university, I study programming, databases, and computer networks. Some courses are difficult, so I often discuss them with my classmates. Explaining an idea to someone else helps me understand it better.
paragraphs.translation: 我叫林，是一名计算机专业学生。我选择这个专业，因为我喜欢解决问题。在大学里，我学习编程、数据库和计算机网络。有些课程很难，所以我经常和同学讨论。向别人解释一个想法能帮助我更好地理解它。

paragraphs.text: This semester, I am building a small website with two friends. It helps students find a quiet place to study. I work on the pages that users see, and my friends work on the data. The website is not finished yet. Our next step is to ask five students to try it and tell us what is confusing.
paragraphs.translation: 这学期，我正和两个朋友制作一个小网站，帮助学生找到安静的学习场所。我负责用户看到的页面，朋友们负责数据。网站还没有完成。下一步是请五名学生试用，告诉我们哪些地方不容易理解。

title: 我的一天
subtitle: Finding time to learn
goal: 读懂时间安排，介绍自己的学习习惯。

paragraphs.text: On weekdays, Maya has classes in the morning. After lunch, she spends an hour in the library. She does not always finish every task, but she writes down the most important one before she starts. This small habit helps her focus. When she gets stuck, she takes a short walk instead of looking at her phone.
paragraphs.translation: 工作日，Maya 上午上课。午饭后，她在图书馆学习一小时。她并不总能完成所有任务，但开始前会写下最重要的一件事。这个小习惯帮助她专注。遇到困难时，她会短暂散步，而不是看手机。

paragraphs.text: In the evening, Maya practises English for fifteen minutes. First, she reads a short text. Then she closes it and explains the main idea aloud. She records her answer and listens once. She chooses just one thing to improve the next day. On Saturdays, she meets a friend to study. Sunday is her day off.
paragraphs.translation: 晚上，Maya 练十五分钟英语。她先读一篇短文，再合上它，大声解释主旨。她录下回答并回听一次，只选一件事情在第二天改进。周六，她和朋友一起学习。周日休息。

title: 读懂一个 README
subtitle: Before you run the project
goal: 识别要求、操作顺序和限制，练习解释运行步骤。

paragraphs.text: A README is usually the first document you see in a software project. It explains what the project does and how to start it. Before copying a command, check the requirements. A project may need a particular version of Node.js or a package manager. If your version is different, the same command may produce a different result.
paragraphs.translation: README 通常是软件项目中最先看到的文档，说明项目用途和启动方式。复制命令前，先检查环境要求。项目可能需要特定版本的 Node.js 或包管理器。版本不同，同样的命令可能得到不同结果。

paragraphs.text: Imagine a README that says: install the dependencies, start the development server, and open the local address printed in the terminal. These steps must be completed in order. The document also says that the sample data is stored in the project. You do not need an account to use it. However, saving your changes requires permission to write to the project folder.
paragraphs.translation: 假设文档写道：安装依赖、启动开发服务器、打开终端输出的本地地址。这些步骤必须按顺序完成。文档还说明示例数据保存在项目内，使用时不需要账号。不过，保存更改需要项目文件夹的写入权限。

title: 把问题说清楚
subtitle: A useful bug report
goal: 区分预期与实际，练习清楚地描述问题。

paragraphs.text: A useful bug report describes what you expected and what actually happened. For example: I expected the search results to update after I changed the filter. Instead, the page showed the old results. A clear comparison helps another developer understand the problem before they open the code.
paragraphs.translation: 一份有用的问题报告说明预期结果和实际结果。例如：我希望修改筛选条件后搜索结果更新，但页面仍显示旧结果。清晰的对比让其他开发者在打开代码前就能理解问题。

paragraphs.text: Next, give the shortest steps that reproduce the problem. Include the browser version and the exact error message, if there is one. Do not guess the cause without evidence. A teammate might find a cause you did not expect. After a fix, repeat the same steps to check the result. A screenshot can help, but it does not replace a clear description.
paragraphs.translation: 接着给出复现问题的最短步骤，附上浏览器版本和具体错误信息。没有证据时，不要猜测原因。同事可能发现你没有想到的原因。修复后重复同样步骤，检查结果。截图有帮助，但不能替代清楚的描述。

title: 雅思：学习与兴趣
subtitle: Study, interests & a useful skill
goal: 用原因和例子扩展回答，练习 Part 1、2、3。

paragraphs.text: Learning a skill is different from memorising a list of facts. When you learn to cook, for example, you need to understand instructions and then try them. The first attempt may fail, but it shows you which part needs attention. Small, regular practice sessions can be easier to maintain than an ambitious schedule that you soon abandon.
paragraphs.translation: 学技能和记住一串事实不一样。比如学做饭，需要先理解步骤，再尝试。第一次可能失败，但会告诉你哪部分需要关注。小而规律的练习比一个很快放弃的宏大计划更容易坚持。

paragraphs.text: Feedback also matters. A teacher can point out a mistake, but the learner still has to practise the new approach. Recording yourself can be useful because you notice things you miss while speaking. You might hear a long pause or find that an example is unclear. The aim is not to remove every mistake at once. It is to choose one useful change and test it in your next attempt.
paragraphs.translation: 反馈也很重要。老师可以指出错误，但学习者仍需练习新方法。录音有帮助，因为你会注意到说话时忽略的地方，比如长停顿或不清楚的例子。目标不是一次消除全部错误，而是选择一项有用的改变，在下一次尝试中检验。

title: 雅思：城市里的绿地
subtitle: Small parks, different needs
goal: 练习判断、信息定位与限词填空。

paragraphs.text: As cities become more crowded, planners look for ways to provide green space close to where people live. Large parks offer room for sport and long walks, but land in city centres can be expensive. Some communities therefore create small parks on unused plots. These spaces may contain just a few trees, benches, and a short path. Their size limits the activities they can support, but a nearby place to sit outside can still be valuable to local residents.
paragraphs.translation: 城市越来越拥挤，规划者寻找办法，在居民住处附近提供绿地。大公园可供运动和长距离散步，但市中心土地可能昂贵。因此，一些社区在闲置地块建设小公园，只有少量树木、长椅和短步道。大小限制了可进行的活动，但附近能坐着休息的户外场所仍对居民有价值。

paragraphs.text: Good design starts by asking how the space will be used. Older residents may need comfortable seating and shade. Families may want a safe place for children, while office workers may visit only during a lunch break. A design that meets one group’s needs may not meet another’s. Planners should also consider maintenance. Trees and paths require care, and this work continues after the opening day. A park that looks attractive in a drawing will not remain useful if nobody maintains it. There is no single design that works in every neighbourhood. The purpose of a small park should guide the decisions about its layout and long-term care.
paragraphs.translation: 好的设计先询问空间用途。老年居民可能需要舒适座位和遮阴，家庭需要儿童安全活动场所，上班族可能只在午休时来。满足一组人的设计不一定满足另一组。还应考虑维护，树木和步道在开放后仍需照料。图纸上漂亮的公园如果无人维护，也无法持续发挥作用。不存在适用于所有社区的设计，布局和长期维护应由用途决定。

speaking.title: 比较不同需求
speaking.prompt: Compare what families and older residents may need in a park. Use “while”.
speaking.sample: Families may need a play area, while older residents may need shade.
speaking.translation: 家庭可能需要游乐区，而老年人可能需要遮阴。

source: LinguaDesk 原创专项练习，非官方真题

title: 项目进度汇报
subtitle: A short team update
goal: 读懂完成项、当前问题与下一步，用三句话汇报进度。

paragraphs.text: At our team meeting, I give a short update. Yesterday, I finished the search page. Today, I will test it on my phone. The page works on my laptop, but the text is too small on a phone. I am fixing that now.
paragraphs.translation: 在团队会议上，我做简短汇报。昨天完成了搜索页面，今天会在手机上测试。页面在笔记本电脑上运行正常，但手机上的文字太小。我正在修复这个问题。

paragraphs.text: I am not blocked, but I need a review. My teammate will check the page this afternoon. My next step is to make the text easier to read. I will ask for help if I find another problem.
paragraphs.translation: 我的工作没有受阻，但需要别人检查。队友今天下午会检查页面。下一步是让文字更容易阅读。如果发现另一个问题，我会寻求帮助。

words.example: Yesterday, I finished the search page.
My next step is to test the page.

marks.note: finish 的过去式，表示已完成。
too + 形容词：过于……，这里表示字太小。
说明下一步的具体动作。
寻求帮助。

pattern.meaning: 用 to + 动词原形说明下一步。
pattern.example: My next step is to test the page.

questions.prompt: What did the writer finish yesterday?
questions.explanation: Yesterday, I finished the search page 明确说明完成项。

questions.prompt: What is the problem on a phone?
questions.explanation: 问题是文字太小，没有说页面打不开或搜索太慢。

questions.prompt: The teammate will check the page this _____.
questions.explanation: 第二段给出的时间是 this afternoon。

questions.prompt: The writer cannot continue working until the review is finished.
questions.explanation: I am not blocked 表示工作没有受阻；需要检查不等于不能继续。

questions.prompt: What will the writer improve next?
options: How easy the text is to read
questions.answer: How easy the text is to read
questions.explanation: make the text easier to read 是下一步行动。

speaking.title: 昨天与今天
speaking.prompt: 听一遍，再跟读。注意 finished 和 will test。
speaking.sample: Yesterday, I finished the search page. Today, I will test it on my phone.
speaking.translation: 昨天完成了搜索页面，今天会在手机上测试。

speaking.title: 做一次进度汇报
speaking.prompt: What have you finished, what are you doing now, and what is your next step?
speaking.sample: Yesterday, I finished the search page. I am fixing the text on mobile now. My next step is to ask a teammate for a review.
speaking.translation: 昨天完成了搜索页面，现在正在调整手机上的文字。下一步是请队友检查。

speaking.title: 替换下一步
speaking.prompt: 用 My next step is to 说一件你下一步要做的事。
speaking.sample: My next step is to test the page.
speaking.translation: 下一步是测试页面。

source: LinguaDesk 原创训练材料，情境为虚构
